schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 4–6 transcript (never shown to students); 7–10 listening answers, the Fógra a hAon grid answers printed after Fógra a Dó, ending with the mark-total boxes on PDF 10; 11 composition marking; 12 the 40-mark table; 31–32 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark bands). PDF 13–30 are Paper 2; 33–36 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2019 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. Sa Spidéal / Gaillimh) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3, the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, recipient (deartháir/deirfiúr) and conversation partner wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2019; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t‐eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; the scheme prints their answers after Fógra a Dó on PDF 7, each as “answer 3 mharc” without “=”, followed by alternatives (“Duine ag canadh = 2 mharc”). Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app).
Fógra a Dó 2(a) prints a bracketed alternative inside its key: “Báisteach/fearthainn = 2 mharc (báisteach/fearthainn throm = 3 mharc)”; it is lifted as printed.

The 2019 composition scheme (PDF 11) prints no per-criterion paragraphs (2020 has “An Tasc (2 mharc) Tá 2 mharc le bronnadh …”, “An tÁbhar (8 marc) Tá 8 marc ag dul don ábhar …”): it prints the tariff table (Tasc = 2 mharc, Ábhar = 8 marc, Cumas Gaeilge = 40 marc), the two Cumas Gaeilge aspects (i)/(ii), the bracketed relevance note “[Ní mór ceangal cinnte leanúnach … nach bhfuil ad rem.]” and the examiner’s recording note. Each criterion carries the printed text that belongs to it: Tasc the tariff table, Ábhar the relevance note, Cumas Gaeilge the (i)/(ii) aspects, the recording note, the 40-mark table (PDF 12) and the SMM bands (PDF 32).
The 2019 paper and scheme print U+2010 hyphens (t‐eolas, t‐ábhar, 0‐6); they are lifted as printed.
No 2019 Ordinary card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.
